key_insight: SkillBrowser lets agents selectively load skills as capability needs emerge, improving accuracy while limiting unnecessary context exposure.
engineering_relevance: On-demand skill loading offers a scalable alternative to exposing entire skill catalogs or relying on static retrieval from the initial task query.
method: Use a Meta-Skill to identify current capability needs during reasoning.
Formulate targeted queries to find relevant skills.
Load procedural content selectively when needed.
evidence_signal: Across six SRA-Bench subsets and five LLMs, SkillBrowser improves aggregate accuracy over static retrieval and LLM-based selection, including multi-step tool use, and reduces degradation on already-solvable instances.
watch_item: Benefits vary by model and task; under-invocation of useful skills and added latency remain limitations.
paper_title: SkillBrowser: Selective Skill Exposure for Scalable Skill-Using Agents
